parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Underline **all** the SI base units in the following list.

ampere             coulomb             current             kelvin             newton

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A toy car moves in a horizontal straight line. The displacement $s$ of the car is given by the equation

$$s = \frac{v^2}{2a}$$

where $a$ is the acceleration of the car and $v$ is its final velocity.

State **two** conditions that apply to the motion of the car in order for the above equation to be valid.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.part_stem:
An experiment is performed to determine the acceleration of the car in **(b)**. The following measurements are obtained:

$s = 3.89\text{ m} \pm 0.5\%$
$v = 2.75\text{ m s}^{-1} \pm 0.8\%$.
parts.text: Calculate the acceleration $a$ of the car.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the percentage uncertainty, to two significant figures, in $a$.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Use your answers in **(c)(i)** and **(c)(ii)** to determine the absolute uncertainty in the calculated value of $a$.
